# 01 - global AGENTS.md only

Contract: `UPSTREAM-CONTRACT.md` Sec.4.3 - the global level is
`${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/AGENTS.md` first (first match wins).

This case has only the XDG-config `AGENTS.md`; there is no project tree file,
so the manifest contains exactly one global instruction and no skills.
